mapper.select: SELECT AUXILIARY_ID as auxiliaryId, AUXILIARY_CODE as auxiliaryCode, AUXILIARY_NAME as auxiliaryName, AUXILIARY_TYPE as auxiliaryType, PARENT_ID as parentId, IS_LEAF as isLeaf, IS_ENABLED as isEnabled, SORT_ORDER as sortOrder, BOOK_ID as bookId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, VERSION as version, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, CREATOR as creator, UPDATER as updater FROM T_AUXILIARY_ITEM WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND AUXILIARY_TYPE = #{auxiliaryType} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND IS_ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, AUXILIARY_CODE ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE T_AUXILIARY_ITEM SET AUXILIARY_CODE = #{auxiliaryCode}, AUXILIARY_NAME = #{auxiliaryName}, AUXILIARY_TYPE = #{auxiliaryType}, PARENT_ID = #{parentId}, IS_LEAF = #{isLeaf}, IS_ENABLED = #{isEnabled}, SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, VERSION = #{version} + 1, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATER = #{updater} WHERE AUXILIARY_ID = #{auxiliaryId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
UPDATE T_AUXILIARY_ITEM SET IS_DELETED = 1, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE AUXILIARY_ID = #{auxiliaryId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
